Details 
 The Doing Cowgirl Stuff Cropped Tee says exactly what it means. Bold, confident, and unapologetically western, this women’s cowgirl cropped tee is made for long days at the barn and nights out with your crew.
 Crafted from 100% ring-spun cotton and pigment washed for a soft, lived-in feel, the Doing Cowgirl Stuff tee delivers broken-in comfort from the first wear. The cropped, boxy fit pairs perfectly with high-rise denim, especially styles from the Kimes Ranch women’s jeans collection at, creating a flattering, modern cowgirl silhouette.
 Easy to throw on, easy to style, and built for women who live the lifestyle every day, this western graphic crop top keeps it fun without sacrificing grit.
